jsii-compile.description: Compiles a jsii/TypeScript project via the jsii CLI.

jsii-docs.description: Generates multi-language API docs via jsii-docgen.

jsii-package.description: Packages jsii bindings for a target language via jsii-pacmak.

jsii-publish.description: Publishes packaged jsii bindings via the matching publib-* CLI.

generate-l1.description: Generates L1 Resource/Component TypeScript source from vendored provider JSON Schema files.
